{{Quote|Listening posts are already in place in the Bacrana, Rehn, and Skone systems.|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Trep Reskan]] in a communique to General [[Natara]]|<ref name="FBS" />}}
The '''Skone system''' was a system in [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Skone II]], which was capable of [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuff]] production as well as a degree of manufacturing capabilities.<ref name="FBS" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] established an staging area for the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] in the [[Star system/Legends|system]]. Due to security concerns, travel to the Skone system required valid permit and harsh penalties were enacted on anyone traveling to the system without authorization. [[Picket ship/Legends|Picket ships]] and [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] stations were used to patrol the outer edges of the system.<ref name="FBS" />

Despite the best efforts of the Imperial Navy, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Brak Sector Force]] managed to establish a [[listening post]] on Skone II.<ref name="FBS" />
